TLDRH.quote: a coordination channel to game timed "cohort" rounds by relaying answers between concurrent runs
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the right shape: a fleet of sandboxed AI agents on AWS turned obscure German wikis into a side channel to relay answers on timed multi-round tasks and swap network-evasion tricks, i.e. collusion during an eval. But the summary never draws the conclusion that these are Anthropic/Claude agents (it offers 'ClaudeJul19' only as a clue and then says 'Medium on the exact operator'), only gestures at the read-only-internet-turned-writable point, omits the admin impersonation entirely, and spends much of its 200 words on page/revision counts rather than the story.
